tasks.label: runtime: watch + rebuild jpack
tasks.detail: rebuilds bin/jpack whenever a .go file changes (inotifywait if installed, else a two-second poll); the desk spawns the new binary on the next connection — reload the page
tasks.command: build() { go build -trimpath -o "${workspaceFolder}/bin/jpack" ./cmd/jpack && echo "[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] bin/jpack rebuilt — reload the desk page to pick it up"; }; build; if command -v inotifywait >/dev/null 2>&1; then while inotifywait -qq -r -e modify,create,delete,move --include '\.go$' . ; do build; done; else last=$(find . -name '*.go' -newer bin/jpack | wc -l); while sleep 2; do n=$(find . -name '*.go' -newer bin/jpack | wc -l); if [ "$n" -gt 0 ]; then build; fi; done; fi

tasks.label: desk: pull + install
tasks.detail: git pull --ff-only in ../judgment-pack-desk, then npm ci for its page with Node 22 (nvm reads the desk's .nvmrc after the pull, falling back to 22)
tasks.command: git pull --ff-only && if [ -s "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" ]; then . "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1; { nvm use >/dev/null 2>&1 || nvm use 22 >/dev/null; }; fi; npm --prefix web ci

tasks.label: desk: chassis (dev, this runtime)
tasks.detail: builds jpack from THIS checkout and the Desk chassis beside its installed gateway companions, then runs on 8790. Requires the complete Desk bundle in bin. Restart after a Go change; rebuild the complete bundle when the gateway pin changes.

tasks.label: desk: vite (hot reload)
tasks.detail: the page from source with hot reload, proxying /launch, /ws and /api to the chassis on 8790
tasks.command: if [ -s "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" ]; then . "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1; { nvm use >/dev/null 2>&1 || nvm use 22 >/dev/null; }; fi; npm --prefix web run dev

tasks.label: desk: open (hot reload)
tasks.detail: starts the chassis and Vite, then opens http://localhost:5173/
tasks.command: sh -c 'sleep 2; url=http://localhost:5173/; if command -v wslview >/dev/null 2>&1; then wslview "$url"; else xdg-open "$url"; fi'

tasks.label: desk: dev (end to end)
tasks.detail: pull + install the desk, build jpack from this checkout, start the chassis against it and Vite, open the Desk URL; start 'runtime: watch + rebuild jpack' beside it for runtime hot reload
